headline: LAA @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 5.04 at OAK 4.26, with a projected total of 9.30. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: LAA moved +0.08 runs while OAK moved +0.50, changing the projected margin by -0.42 runs. The projected total climbed +0.49, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: J.T. Ginn has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Zack Gelof, Nick Kurtz, Shea Langeliers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Carlos Cortes, Jeff McNeil because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
